## What's new

- **The Mac version updates itself.** When a new version is out, click **Update** in the menu bar menu or the notification: Murmur downloads it, checks it, swaps it in and restarts. Because the Mac preview isn't signed by Apple yet, allow Murmur under **Accessibility** again after each update.
- **Back-to-back dictations no longer run together.** A dictation that lands right after another now starts with a space, so "now." and "Where's" no longer paste as "now.Where's".
- **Help in the menu.** It opens the README, which now has a Troubleshooting section and system requirements.
